author: ballzi
body:
I believe I have fairly served my time and will behave better. I have matured a lot over the timestamp. From me getting banned 4 and a half months ago to now. I believe that I am going to be a better person for the community. Pleased be convinced and unban me. Thank you.

IGN: Husslers

Ban reason: Being toxic and saying seriously inappropriate stuff in chat.
